name: Reddio RedSonic Vault stETH double count via permissionless registerErc20
summary: The RedSonic Vault diamond prices its ETH share class from provider legs that read the vault's raw stETH balance, and anyone could register stETH as a separate share class whose assets are that same raw balance. The attacker registered stETH, bought nearly all rsvETH with flash-loaned ETH, deposited stETH to inflate rsvETH's backing without minting rsvETH, then redeemed rsvETH at the inflated rate and withdrew its stETH, draining the vault's native ETH.
notes: DiamondCut Replace routing registerErc20, depositErc20, depositEth and share-token getters to facet 0x92ecc5de (data word 5); manualWithdraw was added to the same facet one block earlier. Last cut before the exploit.
Initial DiamondCut adding InvestmentManagerFacet (data word 58) with getTotalAssetBalance and getRemainingBalance; never recut.
Exact native-ETH depletion of the diamond in source-1 (balance before minus after). The attacker's deposited ETH and stETH are returned within the transaction and are not victim loss.
Raw-balance pricing half of the double count (with its delegatecalled LidoProvider leg, created block 19958201); activated earlier than target-1's facet, so not the knot.
